summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV (Euronext/Nasdaq: LKFT) filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, attaching a press release disclosing the repurchase of 38,537 of its own ordinary shares between June 9-12, 2026, under a share repurchase program announced on June 9, 2026. The shares were bought on Euronext Brussels at an average price of €24.7764, totaling €954,808.90. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the repurchase is an open-market program, reducing outstanding shares. As of June 12, 2026, the company holds 38,537 treasury shares. Watch for continued buyback execution and potential EPS accretion.
